import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from iris.csv
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Melt the data to transform it into a suitable form for plotting
melted_data = pd.melt(data, id_vars='species', value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'])

# Create a boxplot using seaborn to visualize the distribution of sepal/petal measurements
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(data=melted_data, x='variable', y='value', hue='species', palette='viridis')
plt.title('Distribution of Sepal/Petal Measurements by Species')
plt.xlabel('Measurement Type')
plt.ylabel('Value')
plt.legend(title='Species')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
